**National Travel Survey 2002-2024**

Travey survey data from England

Used in `R/nts_histogram` and `R/nts_calibration`

Available from the UK Data Service https://datacatalogue.ukdataservice.ac.uk/studies/study/5340

Extracted in tab format to `input/raw/UKDA`

File location `input/raw/UKDA-5340-tab/tab/trip_eul_2002-2024.tab`


**UK 2011 Census Output Area Centroids**

Centroids for UK Census 2011 Output Areas

Available from UK Open Geography portal https://geoportal.statistics.gov.uk/datasets/90d74027a09147a18c9ca5a783942696_0/

File extracted in csv format

File location `input/raw/Output_Areas_Dec_2011_PWC_2022_-806071369276555851.csv`


**UK 2011 Census Output Area Boundaries**

Boundaries for UK Census 2011 Output Areas

Available from UK Open Geography portal https://geoportal.statistics.gov.uk/datasets/8df53342abe043ab89534214206617ae_0/

File extracted in gpkg format

File location `input/raw/Output_Areas_Dec_2011_Boundaries_EW_BGC_2022_-4410048714460462685.gpkg`


**WP101EW: Population (Workplace population) **

Number of workplaces in census output areas in the Yorkshire and the Humber region

Available from Nomis https://www.nomisweb.co.uk/census/2011/wp101ew

File extracted in csv format

File location `input/raw/workplace_population_yorkshire_humber.csv`


**Ordnance Survey Multimodal Routing Network**

Network dataset with all links, nodes and turn restrictions in the UK, including average car speeds

Available to UK-based researchers from EDINA Digimap https://digimap.edina.ac.uk/ or otherwise commercially from the Ordnance Survey https://www.ordnancesurvey.co.uk/products/os-multi-modal-routing-network

File extracted in gpkg format

File location `input/raw/osmrn.gpkg`
